dataset_name: COMSATS University Islamabad — Attock Campus Knowledge Pack
intended_use: Seed knowledge data for CampusAI chatbot retrieval (RAG/search).
source_policy: Prefer official COMSATS University Islamabad domains and official university guides/news only.
scope_note: This is a curated seed pack based on accessible/indexed official sources, not a full crawl of the requested homepage because that host returned HTTP 403 in the crawler environment.
usage_rules: Do not treat archived events as upcoming events.
Do not present 2025-26 prospectus statistics as live 2026 statistics.
For current class schedules, teachers employed in CampusAI, user profile details, live events, notices, emergencies, and schedule mode, use CampusAI Firestore as the live source of truth.
Use this web knowledge pack for university website facts, departments, published programs, general contacts, policies and historical news only.
Always include or retain source_url and source freshness metadata when retrieving an answer.
If two official pages disagree, show the disagreement or refer the user to the current campus admissions/department office; do not silently guess.
A program mentioned on a university-wide page is not confirmed as offered at Attock unless an Attock-specific page or current admissions guide supports it.
Do not index the website_access_limitation record as a university fact; it is dataset metadata.

documents.title: Attock Campus overview and published statistics
documents.content: COMSATS University Islamabad (CUI) lists Attock as one of its physical campuses. The official Undergraduate Prospectus 2025–26 gives the Attock campus statistics as: established in 2004; 1,805 students; 6,192 graduates; and 102 faculty. These figures are from the 2025–26 prospectus and should not be described as live counts for 2026. For current enrolment, ask the campus administration or consult a newer official publication.

source.title: Undergraduate Prospectus 2025–26
source.publisher: COMSATS University Islamabad (official web domain or official university publication)
source.notes: Period-specific statistics; do not present as real-time data.

documents.title: Attock Campus location and general department contact
documents.content: Official Attock department pages place COMSATS University Islamabad, Attock Campus near Officers Colony, Kamra Road, Attock, Pakistan. The Computer Science department contact page lists phone +92-57-9316330-1 and fax 057-9316329. A separate official campus contact directory lists 057-9049300 for Dr. Moazzam Maqsood, Associate Professor / Head of Department of Computer Science. These are different published contact entries; use the relevant department/contact context and suggest confirming current phone details if a number fails.

source.title: Department of Computer Science — Attock Campus
source.publisher: COMSATS University Islamabad (official web domain or official university publication)
source.notes: A different official contact directory lists 057-9049300 for the Computer Science HoD: https://ww2.comsats.edu.pk/LifeSkills/Contact. Contact details can change.

documents.title: University identity, recognition and semester system
documents.content: CUI stands for COMSATS University Islamabad. The official admission FAQ describes CUI as a federally chartered public-sector university recognized by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan. The FAQ describes a semester system with Spring running February–June and Fall running September–January. Treat semester dates as the general pattern, not confirmation of a specific exam, registration, or class date; use an official current academic calendar for exact dates.

source.title: CUI Admissions — Frequently Asked Questions
source.publisher: COMSATS University Islamabad (official web domain or official university publication)
source.notes: General university information, not Attock-specific. Verify calendar dates from a current official notice.

documents.title: CUI campus list
documents.content: The official CUI admissions FAQ lists the Islamabad, Lahore, Abbottabad, Sahiwal, Vehari, Wah, and Attock campuses. The Virtual Campus is also mentioned in official university publications. Campus availability and programs differ by location. When users ask what is offered at Attock, do not use another campus's program list as if it were Attock's.

documents.title: Department of Computer Science: overview, programs and contact
documents.content: The Department of Computer Science at CUI Attock says its mission is to provide degree programs and courses in Information Sciences and Technology, combining core curriculum with demanding courses and practical/laboratory learning. The department page lists undergraduate programs: BS Computer Science, BS Software Engineering, and BS Artificial Intelligence; graduate programs: MS Computer Science and PhD Computer Science. The reviewed department page identifies Dr. Muazzam Maqsood as Head of Department. Location: Computer Sciences, Academic Block II; near Officers Colony, Kamra Road, Attock, Pakistan. Department phone: +92-57-9316330-1; fax: 057-9316329. Current program offerings should be confirmed against the active admission notice.

documents.title: Computer Science research groups
documents.content: The official Attock Computer Science research page lists groups including PRiDE (Pattern Recognition, Image Intelligence, and Data Engineering), InnoCloudX (distributed and cloud computing), and ICNet (communications and network technologies). PRiDE's described research includes artificial intelligence, pattern recognition, image processing, machine learning, data engineering, and natural language processing. This is research-group information, not a promise that every subject is offered as a degree program.

documents.title: Department of Mathematics overview and programs
documents.content: The official Attock Mathematics page states that the department was established in 2011. It lists the historical program expansion: MSc Mathematics in 2011, MS Mathematics in 2012, BS Mathematics in 2019, PhD Mathematics in 2022, and BS Mathematics with Data Science in 2025. Its current program list includes BS Mathematics, BS Mathematics with Data Science, MS Mathematics, and PhD Mathematics. The page identifies Dr. Asif Waheed as Head of Department and reports 19 faculty members, including 17 PhD scholars. documents.title: How to answer questions about university leadership titles
documents.content: When asked who is the university president, do not invent a “President” title from a page that identifies a Rector. The current central CUI leadership page reviewed for this dataset identifies Prof. Dr. Raheel Qamar, T.I., as Rector. If the user explicitly means the Chancellor, Pro-Rector, or campus In-Charge, search the corresponding official governance page and distinguish the roles. Always cite the title and source used.

documents.title: Official Attock homepage access limitation for this collection
documents.content: The requested official website is https://attock.comsats.edu.pk/. The user's Cursor cloud run and this research environment reported HTTP 403 for the homepage, robots.txt, and sitemap paths. Therefore this pack is not a complete live crawl of that host. It is a curated seed dataset built from publicly indexed pages on official COMSATS University domains, especially legacy Attock-specific department paths under ww2.comsats.edu.pk/*_atk/, plus official CUI-wide publications. Some official pages may be older or may contain inconsistent templates. Keep source URLs and freshness metadata, do not label this dataset as a complete scrape, and replace/refresh records when access is available.
